sections.text: I cut the deploy pipeline from 40 minutes to 9 by caching the Docker layer build and parallelising the test shards.
We disagreed about the rollback plan. I pulled the on-call data, showed two prior incidents where the manual path failed, and we agreed to automate it. The next incident recovered in four minutes.
Bring the migration metrics to the screen. Recruiters at this company ask for concrete before/after numbers.
